Unemployment rate of men vs. women
2025

Unemployment is the share of the
labor force
without work, but actively looking for a job and available to start
Data source: ILO Modelled Estimates, via World Bank (2026)

Note: All figures correspond to
modeled ILO estimates
. Employment is defined in line with the 13th ICLS and includes the production of goods
for own use, such as subsistence farming. Where a country or region lacks data for the year shown, the closest available value within 5 years is
